name: Ramappa Temple (Palampet)
description: 13th-century Kakatiya masterpiece famous for floating light-weight bricks, sandbox foundations, and fine Madanika sculptures.

name: Bogatha Waterfalls (Cheekupalle)
description: Known as the 'Niagara of Telangana', a broad jungle waterfall set in the dense forest heartland.

name: Tadvai Forest Huts & Eco-Tourism
description: Teak forest camping retreat offering canopy walks, bird watching, tree houses, and forest cycling.

name: Laknavaram Lake
description: Massive Kakatiya-era reservoir featuring 160-meter hanging suspension bridges connecting island resorts.

name: Eturnagaram Wildlife Sanctuary
description: One of the oldest wildlife sanctuaries in Telangana, covering rich teak forests and sanctuary wildlife.

name: Kongala Waterfalls
description: A secluded, natural cascade nestled deep within the Eturnagaram forest range.

name: Ghanpur Kota Gullu
description: A group of 22 ancient Kakatiya-era stone temples displaying intricate architectural carvings.

name: Damarvai Dolmens
description: Ancient megalithic burial structures built thousands of years ago in the Tadvai forest zone.

name: Pandavula Guhalu (Caves)
description: Natural rock shelter caves featuring prehistoric rock art, weapons drawings, and ancient tribal figures.

name: Medaram Tribal Museum
description: Official museum showcasing Koya tribal heritage, life history of Sammakka, ritual weapons, and musical instruments.

name: Malluru Hemachala Temple
description: Ancient forest hill temple dedicated to Lord Narasimha Swamy with natural medicinal water springs.

name: Kaleshwaram Temple & Triveni Sangam
description: Sacred confluence of Godavari and Pranahita rivers, famous for its unique twin-linga Shiva temple.
